from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, DateTime, ForeignKey, Boolean
from sqlalchemy.sql import func
from gossipmesh.models.base import Base

class ApprovalGate(Base):
    __tablename__ = "approval_gates"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    workflow_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("workflows.id"), nullable=True, index=True)
    repository_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("repositories.id"), nullable=True, index=True)
    action_type = Column(String(50), nullable=False)  # push_commit, create_pr, post_review, apply_patch
    status = Column(String(20), default="pending", nullable=False)  # pending, approved, rejected, expired
    diff_content = Column(Text, nullable=True)
    commit_sha = Column(String(100), nullable=True)
    approver_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("users.id"), nullable=True)
    approved_at = Column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True)
    expires_at = Column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), nullable=False)
    updated_at = Column(DateTime(timezone=True), onupdate=func.now(), server_default=func.now(), nullable=False)

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from typing import List, Optional
from pydantic import BaseModel

from gossipmesh.api import deps
from gossipmesh.models.user import User
from gossipmesh.models.approval import ApprovalGate
from gossipmesh.runtime.workflow import WorkflowManager
from gossipmesh.models.audit import AuditEvent

router = APIRouter(prefix="/approvals", tags=["approvals"])

class ApprovalCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    workflow_id: Optional[int] = None
    repository_id: Optional[int] = None
    action_type: str
    diff_content: Optional[str] = None
    commit_sha: Optional[str] = None
    expires_in_hours: int = 24

class ApprovalDecisionRequest(BaseModel):
    decision: str  # approved, rejected

class ApprovalResponse(BaseModel):
    id: int
    workflow_id: Optional[int]
    repository_id: Optional[int]
    action_type: str
    status: str
    diff_content: Optional[str]
    commit_sha: Optional[str]
    approver_id: Optional[int]
    approved_at: Optional[datetime]
    expires_at: datetime
    created_at: datetime

    class Config:
        from_attributes = True

@router.post("/", response_model=ApprovalResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def create_approval_gate(
    req: ApprovalCreateRequest,
    db: Session = Depends(deps.get_db),
    current_user: User = Depends(deps.get_current_active_user),
):
    expires_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(hours=req.expires_in_hours)
    gate = ApprovalGate(
        workflow_id=req.workflow_id,
        repository_id=req.repository_id,
        action_type=req.action_type,
        status="pending",
        diff_content=req.diff_content,
        commit_sha=req.commit_sha,
        expires_at=expires_at,
    )
    db.add(gate)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(gate)
    return gate

@router.get("/{approval_id}", response_model=ApprovalResponse)
def get_approval_gate(
    approval_id: int,
    db: Session = Depends(deps.get_db),
    current_user: User = Depends(deps.get_current_active_user),
):
    gate = db.query(ApprovalGate).filter(ApprovalGate.id == approval_id).first()
    if not gate:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Approval gate not found")
    
    # Check expiration
    if gate.status == "pending" and gate.expires_at < datetime.now(timezone.utc):
        gate.status = "expired"
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(gate)

    return gate

@router.post("/{approval_id}/decision", response_model=ApprovalResponse)
def decide_approval(
    approval_id: int,
    req: ApprovalDecisionRequest,
    db: Session = Depends(deps.get_db),
    current_user: User = Depends(deps.get_current_active_user),
):
    gate = db.query(ApprovalGate).filter(ApprovalGate.id == approval_id).first()
    if not gate:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Approval gate not found")

    if gate.status != "pending":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Approval gate is already {gate.status}")

    if gate.expires_at < datetime.now(timezone.utc):
        gate.status = "expired"
        db.commit()
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Approval gate has expired")

    if req.decision not in ["approved", "rejected"]:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid decision. Must be 'approved' or 'rejected'")

    gate.status = req.decision
    gate.approver_id = current_user.id
    if req.decision == "approved":
        gate.approved_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        if gate.workflow_id:
            wm = WorkflowManager(db)
            wm.approve_patch(gate.workflow_id, actor_id=current_user.id)

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(gate)
    return gate

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

from gossipmesh.api.main import app
from gossipmesh.api import deps
from gossipmesh.models.base import Base
from gossipmesh.models.user import User
from gossipmesh.models.approval import ApprovalGate

SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URL = "sqlite:///:memory:"

engine = create_engine(
    SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URL, connect_args={"check_same_thread": False}
)
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)

Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

def override_get_db():
try:
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    yield db
finally:
    db.close()

def override_get_current_user():
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    user = db.query(User).filter(User.email == "approver@gossipmesh.test").first()
    if not user:
        user = User(email="approver@gossipmesh.test", hashed_password="dummy", is_active=True, is_superuser=True)
        db.add(user)
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(user)
    db.close()
    return user

app.dependency_overrides[deps.get_db] = override_get_db
app.dependency_overrides[deps.get_current_active_user] = override_get_current_user

client = TestClient(app)

def test_approval_gate_lifecycle():
    # Create approval request
    response = client.post(
        "/approvals/",
        json={
            "action_type": "push_commit",
            "diff_content": "--- a/file.py\n+++ b/file.py\n+print('hello')",
            "commit_sha": "abc1234",
            "expires_in_hours": 1
        }
    )
    assert response.status_code == 201
    data = response.json()
    approval_id = data["id"]
    assert data["status"] == "pending"
    assert data["commit_sha"] == "abc1234"

    # Get approval status
    res_get = client.get(f"/approvals/{approval_id}")
    assert res_get.status_code == 200
    assert res_get.json()["status"] == "pending"

    # Approve
    res_decide = client.post(
        f"/approvals/{approval_id}/decision",
        json={"decision": "approved"}
    )
    assert res_decide.status_code == 200
    decide_data = res_decide.json()
    assert decide_data["status"] == "approved"
    assert decide_data["approver_id"] is not None
    assert decide_data["approved_at"] is not None
